name: Salamangreat Bastella
desc: If you control no monsters, or all monsters you control are "Salamangreat" monsters: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can increase or decrease the Level of 1 monster on the field by 1. If you Link Summon a Link-3 or higher FIRE Link Monster while this card is in your GY: You can banish this card; Set 1 "Salamangreat" Trap from your Deck. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Bastella" once per turn.
